measurement.successDefinition: callback monotonic T1-T0 is in [0, 50] ms; failure is early or over tolerance, not a pre-measurement assertion
measurement.clockNote: Epoch uses Date.now (integer ms); monotonic uses performance.now. T0 is sampled scheduling time + 5 ms. Epoch/monotonic offset is sampled within this process only; it is not cross-process synchronization. Clock adjustments can change epoch differences independently.
measurement.loadNote: CPU-load run deliberately blocks the measuring event loop for 8 ms immediately after each 5 ms timer is scheduled. This is a contention experiment, not a nonblocking scheduler or whole-machine saturation test.
measurement.cleanup: No workers, intervals, or persistent timers; every single-shot timer completed before writing the report.
